en:
## Refactoring

- Improved Anthropic interleaved thinking support: thinking/text/tool_use blocks now preserve their original order from the API response instead of using a fixed ordering
- Unified content block sorting in pushAssistantTurn, eliminating duplicated code paths for interleaved vs legacy modes
- Text blocks now capture their native outputIndex from Anthropic SSE events, replacing the previous heuristic-based positioning
- Stripped internal-only markers from reasoning blocks before passing to downstream consumers
- History reconstruction (buildAnthropicHistory) now uses a single-pass iteration over contentJson to preserve interleaved block positions, with backward compatibility for older messages
zh-CN:
## 重构

- 改进 Anthropic 交错思考支持：thinking/text/tool_use 块现在保持 API 响应的原始顺序，而非固定排列
- 统一 pushAssistantTurn 的内容块排序逻辑，消除 interleaved/legacy 两个重复代码路径
- text 块现在从 Anthropic SSE 事件中捕获原生 outputIndex，替代之前的启发式位置推断
- 剥离 reasoning 块的内部标记，防止泄漏到下游消费者
- 历史重建（buildAnthropicHistory）改为单趟遍历 contentJson 以保持交错块位置，同时向后兼容旧消息格式
